column1: # REVIEWED rows for the h3maped image.
# ownership=whole-section requires complete native byte/relocation verification; - makes no claim about unnamed interior entries.
# Whole-section claims were checked against full pinned COFF sections and every relocation; folded source-owned copies remain aliases.

column8: evidence
memcpy.obj and memmove.obj assemble to the same 821 bytes and both are linked; placed callers of _memcpy reach this copy (TGzInflateBuf::underflow 0x449ab6, InitializeArtifactTraitsTable 0x4036a8)
the other of the two identical copies; placed callers of _memmove reach it (basic_string::replace 0x49125b)

strcat.obj's _strcpy and mbscat.obj's __mbscpy are the same 16 bytes; the image holds one copy, so one member is linked, and placed callers of _strcpy reach it (InitializeHeroTraits 0x44cd9f, InitializePlayerTraitsTable 0x494324)
CGdiObject::DeleteObject; the shell calls it from the GDI object destructors (TTileHRuler::~TTileHRuler 0x4beb83)
CGdiObject::Detach; its callers (TTileHRuler::OnSize 0x4bf2ba) reach it
CGdiObject::Attach; its callers (TTileHRuler::OnSize 0x4bf2e9) reach it

CClientDC::CClientDC and CWindowDC::CWindowDC agree except the GetDC/GetWindowDC import the masked census match ignores; this copy calls GetDC and stores CClientDC's vtable (TTileHRuler::setHighlight 0x4bec40 constructs a client DC here)
the CPen, CBrush and CFont SelectObject overloads are the same 70 bytes, folded to one copy; TGDIObjectSelector<CPen>/<CBrush> instances and the font selector reach it

stricmp.obj's __stricmp under its OLDNAMES spelling: the Libraries' LODFile::Find (0x4e3f40) calls strcmpi, which LINK binds to this body
fopen.obj and wfopen.obj assemble to the same 19 bytes and differ only in the opener they call; LODFile::open (0x4e4180) calls _fopen here
fread.obj and fwrite.obj assemble to the same 47 bytes and differ in the locked worker they call; LODFile::open and read (0x4e4180, 0x4e4370) call _fread here
the Attach members share their masked bytes; this copy calls afxMapHMENU (the map edit window's context menu 0x46e3c4 attaches its popup here)
the Detach members share their masked bytes; this copy calls afxMapHMENU and CMenu::DestroyMenu 0x504da0 reaches it
CGdiObject::DeleteObject's twin with the DestroyMenu import (the map edit window's CMenu destructor 0x46e572 calls it)
throws length_error with "string too long" (0x54cf70); 3 placed call sites pair with it
11-byte body equal to abs.obj; 6 placed call sites pair with it
xstod.obj's _Stof and _Stold are the same 21 bytes and the image holds one; placed callers of either reach it
